svg.title: Dashboard journey
svg.desc: The dashboard loads the stored index and stops with pipeline instructions if it is empty. Otherwise five tabs show overall scores, a bank-by-aspect heat map, a time series, evidence sentences and a chat. The Chat tab passes each question to a Conversation, which runs the chatbot.

display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Show the pipeline commands
and stop

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Overview
all-time score per bank with n,
score split by source,
analyst consensus from Yahoo

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Aspect Heatmap
bank × aspect scores,
and n per cell

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Time Series
pick bank and aspect:
7d, 30d and all-time scores,
line by month, quarter or week

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Evidence
pick bank and aspect:
30 most recent sentences
with source, label and link

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Chat
click a suggestion
or type a question

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
